salary: Selected candidates are engaged as Job Trainees at a fixed Rs. 35,000/- per month , uniform across all 22 subjects, under the Department of Personnel's notification No. Per(AP)-C-B(15)-3/2024 dated 19 July 2025, which governs the job-trainee engagement scheme across HP Government departments.

application_fee: The application fee is a flat Rs. 600 for all candidates, paid online via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or other digital modes, and is non-refundable and non-transferable once paid. Since each subject is a separate application, the fee must be paid afresh for every subject applied to. || Visithttp://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc. || Click"Apply Online"on the homepage. || Select"One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations"and complete registration if new. || Log in to the OTR account and view live advertisements on the dashboard. || Select the relevant subject advertisement (e.g., Hindi – 47/6-2026, History – 48/6-2026) and fill the form. || Upload scanned Matriculation certificate, degree/marksheets, category certificate, and Bonafide HP certificate. || Pay theRs. 600 feeonline. || Confirm the undertaking on document legibility and submit the final application. || Download the confirmation/printout for records. || Once submitted, no corrections or modifications are allowed , so candidates should verify every field before final submission.
selection_process: Selection runs through a two-paper written test on the same day, followed by a Personality Test , with final merit based on Paper-II plus interview marks. The process starts with document scrutiny and ends with a 30-mark interview at HPPSC's Shimla office. || Paper-I is qualifying only and does not count toward merit; candidates scoring zero or negative marks are excluded outright. There is 0.25 mark negative marking per wrong, multiple, or blank answer in objective tests, and the SAT qualifying mark is 45% General / 40% Reserved .
